FORM GST RFD-08 SHOW CAUSE NOTICE
Notice Ref: RFD08/TN/2023/808 Dated 12-12-2023
GSTIN: 33GGGHH7890G1Z1 M/s Global Garments Exports
FY: 2023-24

1. Reference refund application ARN AA3308230012345 filed for refund of unutilized Input Tax Credit of Rs. 3,50,000/- on account of zero-rated export of goods without payment of tax under LUT.
2. On examination, it is proposed to reject the refund claim under Section 54 alleging non-submission of Bank Realization Certificate (BRC) / FIRC within statutory period.
